question: GQ-006
subject: testing the "needs hardware" deferral, and what I could actually check
the_deferral: "The single-volume vault risk needs hardware Shaan controls."

reassessed.finding: A second copy ON THE SAME DEVICE is trivially possible — there is 3.8Ti free. I dismissed it because it does not survive drive failure, which conflated two different risks.
reassessed.verdict: The deferral stands, but for a narrower reason than I gave. It is not that no second copy is possible — it is that a same-device copy addresses risks which have not materialised (zero losses so far) while doubling 45G, and the risk that WOULD justify it needs a second device. My original phrasing implied nothing could be done at all.

what_i_did_instead.action: pragma quick_check on every vaulted database
what_i_did_instead.why_skipped: quick_check on multi-GB files over USB exceeds ten minutes — the same limit that stalled the gate chain earlier today.

honest_limit: 8 of 12, not 12 of 12. The four largest are unverified TODAY, though passages.sqlite was checked by banded checksum across 250,005 rows and both logs were quick_checked when written. Reporting "all vault databases verified" would be false.
